Class ConsoleUI

java.lang.Object
boundary.ConsoleUI
public class ConsoleUI extends Object
Handles all console output for Restaurant Rush. Keeps the display separate from the game rules. All input is read by InputReader, so the game has only one Scanner on System.in.

Every method here only prints. None of them changes the game.

Author:
CT2003 Group 3

    • showTurnStatus

      public void showTurnStatus(int revenueCents, int paidCustomers, int avgSatisfaction)
      Displays the running score at the start of a turn: revenue so far and the average satisfaction of paid customers ("N/A" until someone pays).

      revenueCents - the revenue so far, in cents

    • showTurnResults

      public void showTurnResults(int turnsUsed, int totalTurns, int served, int departures, int revenueCents, int paidCustomers, int avgSatisfaction)
      Displays the results at the end of a turn: served count, unhappy departures, revenue, average satisfaction of paid customers and turns used.
      Parameters:
      turnsUsed - how many turns have been played, including this one
      totalTurns - the number of turns in the game
      served - how many customers have been served so far
      departures - how many customers have left unhappy so far
      revenueCents - the revenue so far, in cents
      paidCustomers - how many customers have paid so far
      avgSatisfaction - the average satisfaction of paid customers; ignored when nobody has paid

    • showHappyHourOffer

      public void showHappyHourOffer(int discountPercent, int recoveryPoints, int durationTurns)
      Offers the manager the chance to start Happy Hour this turn (Stage 3). The numbers come from the game setting, so this method holds no rules.
      Parameters:
      discountPercent - the discount on orders taken during Happy Hour, e.g. 20
      recoveryPoints - the satisfaction waiting customers recover each Happy Hour turn, e.g. 15
      durationTurns - how many turns Happy Hour lasts, e.g. 2

      public void showResults(int actualPaid, int targetPaid, int actualRev, int targetRev, int actualSat, int targetSat, boolean isVictory)
      Displays the end game results and whether the player achieved victory.
